descriptionHtml:
Experience running nirvana with the ASICS GEL-1130. Spanning decades of design evolution, these innovation-led sneakers enhance your high-impact strides while paying homage to the ninth iteration of the GEL-1000 series. Powered by suede overlays and breathable mesh underlays, these reimagined silhouettes are true masterpieces that make each run a celebration of your passion for brilliance.

The repurposed traditional materials with synthetic leather paneling evolve these shoes for a more modern aesthetic. Plus, the GEL technology in the heel lets you log those long hours of runs with excellent shock absorption and cushioning. Your secret to comfort-fueled running victories – the ASICS GEL-1130 lets you unlock your true potential.

  • Upper inspired by compositional elements of GEL-KAYANO 14 preserves the TRUSSTIC support system and adds stability.
  • Dyed sockliner helps reduce overall water usage by approx. 33% and carbon emissions by approx. 45% and offers sustainable comfort.

Heritage running DNA meets street-ready style in the ASICS GEL-1130, a retro-inspired silhouette rooted in the GEL-1000 series lineage that delivers cloud-like comfort whether you're logging miles or putting together a fresh everyday look. The breathable mesh upper pairs with suede and synthetic leather overlays for a layered build that holds its own across long days, while heel GEL technology cushions every stride with proven shock absorption. Built with a TRUSSTIC support system borrowed from the GEL-KAYANO 14 and a sustainably dyed sockliner, the GEL-1130 earns its place as a go-to for comfort and style in equal measure.

  • Breathable mesh upper with suede and synthetic leather overlays for structure and airflow
  • Heel GEL technology delivers targeted shock absorption and underfoot cushioning

The GEL-1130 fits true to size for most wearers. For the best fit, we recommend ordering your standard size. Those between sizes or with a wider foot may find going up a half size gives a more comfortable feel.

Best For

Perfect for wearers who want all-day comfort and retro running style across casual outings, long shifts, and everyday wear.

Cushioning & Road Feel

Heel GEL cushioning absorbs impact across a variety of surfaces, while the structured midsole delivers stable, comfortable strides mile after mile. The GEL-1130's layered sole construction keeps underfoot feel consistently smooth and plush, from the sidewalk to the track.

Break-In & Durability

Reviewers consistently report the GEL-1130 feels comfortable right out of the box, with wearers noting the shoes continue to look and feel fresh even after weeks of regular use, a strong reflection of ASICS' build quality at this price point.

descriptionHtml:
Underpronators to mild overpronators will be treated to the lightest and most cushioned version of the GEL-Cumulus ever.

  • Refined open mesh with Discrete Eyelets that disburse lace tension for a customized fit and enhanced upper comfort.
  • ComforDry Sockliner for cushioning performance and anti-odor properties for a cooler, drier, healthier environment.
  • Heel and forefoot GEL Cushioning Systems.
  • Guidance Trusstic System integrates Guidance Line construction for enhanced gait efficiency while providing midfoot structural integrity.
  • Guidance Line vertical flex groove decouples the tooling along the line of progression for enhanced gait efficiency.
  • FluidRide for the ultimate combination of bounce back and cushioning properties with reduced weight and exceptional durability.
  • Impact Guidance System (I.G.S.) employs linked componentry to enhance the foot's natural gait from heel strike to toe-off.
  • Solid rubber outsole.
  • Wt. 8.5 oz.

Daily miles feel smoother when comfort, support, and a consistent ride come together. The ASICS GEL-Cumulus 16 is built to help keep your stride cushioned from heel strike to toe-off, with a breathable upper and responsive platform that works well for everything from training runs to long days on your feet.

  • Refined open-mesh upper with Discrete Eyelets to help distribute lace tension for a more customized fit
  • ComforDry Sockliner adds underfoot cushioning and helps keep the interior feeling fresh
  • FluidRide midsole balances lightweight cushioning with bounce-back response and durability
  • Guidance Trusstic System and Guidance Line construction support smoother transitions
  • Approximate weight: 8.5 oz.

Size & Fit Guidance

For the best fit, we recommend starting with your usual size. Reviewers often describe the feel as secure and supportive, while runners who prefer a little extra room up front for longer miles may like going up a half size.

Cushioning & Road Feel

This ride leans comfortably cushioned without losing its smooth, steady feel on the road. GEL cushioning in the heel and forefoot helps soften impact, while the Guidance Line and FluidRide platform help keep transitions efficient and natural through each step.

Break-In & Durability

Many reviewers highlight step-in comfort right away, with several noting the shoe feels ready to run in from the first wear. Longtime fans also call out lasting comfort over repeated miles, making it a strong option for regular rotation use.

descriptionHtml:
Like a trusted compass for your feet, the ASICS GEL-Kayano 20 guides every journey with precision. Launched in 2013, these sneakers blend comfort and innovation with dual GEL inserts and a GUIDANCE TRUSSTIC system for lasting support and stability mile after mile. Up top, the architectural aesthetics inspired by buildings and cars create a bold, distinctive look that reflects the technical aesthetic of the 2010s, whispering understated sophistication. Underneath, GEL cushioning in the rearfoot and forefoot absorbs impact to keep your stride light, no matter the distance. Featuring an upper with at least 30% synthetic fibre, these shoes strike a perfect balance between sustainability and performance without compromising on style. Carry the weight of history and the lightness of innovation with the ASICS GEL-Kayano 20.

ASICS GEL-Kayano 20 features:

  • FLUIDFIT cage upper ensures a supportive, glove-like fit.
  • Criss-cross TPU application provides targeted support.
  • Mesh underlays offer breathability.
  • Rubber outsole delivers superior traction.

Twenty years of distance-running refinement come together in the ASICS GEL-Kayano 20, a milestone edition that celebrates two decades of the iconic Kayano franchise. Dual GEL technology in both the rearfoot and forefoot absorbs the impact of every footstrike, while the GUIDANCE TRUSSTIC system keeps your stride stable and efficient mile after mile. Architectural aesthetics inspired by the bold design language of the 2010s give the silhouette a distinctive look that carries just as much presence on the street as it does on the road.

  • FLUIDFIT cage upper delivers a supportive, glove-like fit that adapts to your foot shape.
  • Criss-cross TPU application provides targeted structural support across the midfoot.
  • Mesh underlays keep airflow moving to reduce heat buildup on longer efforts.
  • Dual GEL cushioning in the rearfoot and forefoot softens impact through every phase of your stride.
  • GUIDANCE TRUSSTIC system enhances stability and promotes a natural, efficient gait cycle.
  • Rubber outsole with multi-directional lugs delivers reliable traction across road surfaces.
  • Upper constructed with at least 30% synthetic fiber, balancing performance and sustainability.

Cushioning & Road Feel

The dual-zone GEL setup is built for runners who go the distance, with rearfoot absorption managing heel-strike impact and forefoot GEL keeping toe-off smooth and responsive. Paired with the GUIDANCE TRUSSTIC system, the midsole geometry promotes a consistent, efficient stride whether you are logging easy recovery miles or pushing toward a personal best.

Twenty years of distance-running refinement come together in the ASICS GEL-Kayano 20, a milestone edition that celebrates two decades of the iconic Kayano franchise. Recycled materials in the upper and a solution-dyed sockliner add a more thoughtful finish to your daily training rotation.

  • Engineered jacquard mesh upper delivers breathable comfort.

Detailed with an archival buckle in a nod to our heritage, this clog is crafted in a mix of velvety soft suede and our Signature jacquard. The easy slip-on-and-go style is finished with a comfortable molded footbed and a rubber outsole for added traction. Our Signature Jacquard is made with a blend of 46% recycled polyester and 54% regenerative cotton sourced from farms that use regenerative agricultural practices—those that help to maintain and rejuvenate land, increase biological diversity and soil health, and could lead to increased carbon absorption. It reflects our ongoing commitment to helping reduce our impact on the planet.

Product Specifications

  • Upper Material: Suede and Signature jacquard upper
  • Lining: Fabric / Polyester
  • Heel / Sole: Standard

title: Brooks Ghost Max 3 - Men's - Acid Lime/Navy/Black
material: Premium upper with durable overlays and responsive traction outsole

specifications.Material: Premium upper with durable overlays and responsive traction outsole

descriptionHtml:
'

Ghost your limits and discover a new level of running bliss! Designed for avid runners and walkers, the Brooks Ghost Max 3 transforms every stride into something supernatural. Featuring soft cushioning and a rocker shape, these shoes smooth your transition from landing to toe-off, delivering a comfy, cloud-like ride. Your new best friend on the road to fitness, the Brooks Ghost Max 3 reduces pressure underfoot and keeps you supported and protected mile after mile.

  • High-quality materials offer comfort and durability.
  • Broad base adds stability.

Long walks, recovery miles, and full days on your feet feel easier in the Brooks Ghost Max 3. Designed for runners and walkers who want a smooth, highly cushioned ride, it combines soft underfoot comfort with a stable platform and rocker geometry to help each step flow from landing to toe-off.

  • Soft cushioning helps reduce underfoot pressure.
  • Rocker-shaped design promotes smooth transitions.
  • Broad base adds a stable, grounded feel.
  • Breathable upper supports everyday comfort.

Size & Fit Guidance

For the best fit, most reviewers say their usual size works well, with a roomy forefoot that feels especially comfortable through the toe box. If you prefer a little more space up front or wear orthotics, the accommodating shape may be a plus.

Best For

Best for daily walks, easy runs, recovery miles, and long hours of standing when comfort and support are the priority.

Cushioning & Road Feel

Reviewers consistently highlight the plush, protective ride, often describing it as soft without feeling overly squishy. The feel underfoot leans smooth and supportive, making it a strong choice for steady miles and everyday movement rather than a stripped-down, minimal road shoe.

Break-In & Durability

Most reviewers say the Ghost Max 3 feels comfortable right out of the box with little to no break-in time. For walking, standing, and regular training use, it earns strong marks for lasting comfort, while high-mileage runners may want to refresh pairs once the cushioning no longer feels as lively.

Care & Maintenance

A quick wipe-down helps keep the upper looking fresh, especially on lighter colorways. Some reviewers also recommend checking the sockliner occasionally and brushing away small debris to keep the underfoot feel smooth.

descriptionHtml:
Pre-owned and now (re)loved, this Nolita Wristlet 24 is a very special Coach custom design inspired by our commitment to rethinking and reducing our impact on the planet. Saved from the landfill, this gently-worn bag was lovingly repaired and transformed by our in-house craftspeople who added clever details to give it a second life. It’s completely one-of-a-kind, and comes with its own unique set of charms. Wear it, love it, pass it on. Reimagined by Rose Oliva with tonal hand-laced whipstitching for a distinctive touch, this zip-top style has been expertly cleaned, conditioned and restored. Our talented craftspeople Fernando Gutierrez and Yngrid Pichardo Baez embellished the piping with sleek whipstitching, attached a whipstitched short strap with dogleashes and anchors, repaired edgestain, then added a playful repurposed charm. Named for the hip downtown New York neighborhood, the Nolita Wristlet 24 features a convertible chain strap that allows you to carry it as a clutch or top handle. An ideal grab-and-go style, it's crafted of polished pebble leather embellished with floral rivets.

descriptionHtml:
'

From dominating the paint to winning MVP titles, A'ja Wilson's journey is one of unstoppable power and dedication‚ÄîBring that same strength to your game with the Nike A'Ja. Inspired by the unstoppable force that is A'ja Wilson, these shoes are built to fuel your game at every level. The plush Cushlon 3.0 foam delivers unmatched comfort, giving you the energy return you need to stay fresh and relentless from tip-off to buzzer. The extended heel bump provides extra stability to help you explode when it matters the most. Topped off with A'ja's bold, strong, and playful logo, these signature shoes are an ultimate reminder to be unapologetic on the court. Give your best performance every single time and show the world what you're made of with the Nike A'Ja.

Nike A'Ja features:

  • Light and breathable mesh offers comfort.
  • Midfoot band provides optimal arch support and movement control.
  • Soft, stable foam combined with a generative micro-tuned traction pattern adds support.
*The Nike A'One is now available in men's sizes. For women, order 1.5 sizes down. Example: Women's 10.5 = Men's 9.

When the game speeds up, this signature pair helps you stay confident from first cut to final bucket. Built for A'ja Wilson's all-around style, the Nike A'One pairs plush Cushlon 3.0 foam with breathable support and a stable heel design so you can move comfortably and play with purpose.

  • Light, breathable mesh upper for airflow and a comfortable feel
  • Cushlon 3.0 foam for plush cushioning and lasting comfort
  • Midfoot band for arch support and movement control
  • Generative micro-tuned traction pattern and extended heel design for grip and stability

Size & Fit Guidance

For the best fit, most reviewers recommend going up half a size, especially if you like a little extra room through the forefoot. The overall feel is sleek and close to the foot, so players with wider feet may prefer a roomier basketball fit, while some narrow-footed wearers enjoy the locked-in shape.

Best For

Best for indoor players who want strong traction, lightweight cushioning, and a snug, court-ready feel that can also carry off the hardwood.

Court Feel & Traction

Reviewers consistently call out the grip as a standout, with confident bite for quick stops, cuts, and changes of direction. The supportive, low-profile ride helps keep you connected to the floor, and the outsole performs best when kept clean on dusty courts.

Break-In & Durability

Some players say the upper and collar feel better after a few sessions, settling into a more natural fit as the shoe breaks in. Once dialed in, the platform is appreciated for its stable feel, though glossy logo details may show cosmetic scuffs with heavy use.

Care & Maintenance

For best traction, give the outsole a quick wipe during dusty runs. If you're wearing them often on and off the court, be mindful of abrasive surfaces to help keep the finish looking fresh.

descriptionHtml:
Pieces of the past add up to an amazing look for right now with the Nike P-6000, which draws from the Nike Air Pegasus 25 and the Pegasus 2006 for a mash-up of iconic styles that's breathable, comfortable, and evocative of that early-2000s vibe.

  • Breathable mesh has real and synthetic leather overlays to give a 2000s running aesthetic.
  • Foam midsole provides lightweight cushioning for a plush underfoot feel.
  • No-slip full rubber outsole gives you durable traction.
  • Tongue webbing features "Bowerman Series" branding.
  • Nike logo on tongue tab.
  • Molded synthetic leather Swoosh design.

When early-2000s running design meets everyday wearability, the result is something worth reaching for every time. The Nike P-6000 pulls design DNA from the Nike Air Pegasus 25 and Pegasus 2006, blending two iconic silhouettes into a mash-up that's breathable, comfortable, and built for the moments between workouts just as much as the workouts themselves.

  • Breathable mesh upper with real and synthetic leather overlays delivers a classic 2000s running aesthetic.
  • Foam midsole provides lightweight cushioning for a plush, comfortable feel underfoot.
  • Full rubber outsole offers durable, no-slip traction on everyday surfaces.
  • Tongue webbing features "Bowerman Series" branding as a nod to Nike's running heritage.
  • Nike logo on the tongue tab and a molded synthetic leather Swoosh round out the retro look.

Size & Fit Guidance

The P-6000 fits true to size for most wearers. Reviewers also point to a roomier toe box that works well for those who typically find Nikes a touch narrow — order your standard size with confidence.

Best For

Ideal for casual outings, sporting events, and anyone who wants a stylish retro runner that holds its own across everyday life.

Styling & Versatility

The P-6000's layered mesh and leather upper, chunky midsole profile, and Pegasus-inspired lines make it a versatile piece that pairs naturally with athletic wear, joggers, or relaxed denim. Available across multiple colorways, there's a combination to suit just about any wardrobe.

Break-In & Durability

The structured sole delivers firm, supportive cushioning that works well for casual walks and daily errands — those logging longer distances may want a few wears to let the shoe fully conform to their stride. Build quality earns strong marks from reviewers, with many noting it holds up well even under daily use.

descriptionHtml:
For athletic style as legendary as a winged horse, look no farther than Nike’s P-6000. This revolutionary shoe combines features from the Pegasus 25 and the Pegasus 2006 for a truly unique design. Leather, textile, and synthetic materials form a striking upper, while a foam midsole cushions each and every step.

Best For

Styling & Versatility

The layered design gives the P-6000 that standout retro running look while still feeling easy to style. It pairs naturally with leggings, denim, joggers, and casual workday fits when you want sporty comfort without sacrificing looks.

Break-In & Durability

Many reviewers say the P-6000 feels comfortable right out of the box, with little to no break-in needed. The mixed-material upper and rubber outsole are built to handle frequent rotation for walking, commuting, and everyday wear.

To keep them looking fresh, clean the mesh and overlays with a soft brush or cloth and mild soap. Some reviewers also note that the shoe is easy to clean, which makes it a strong pick for regular wear.

Best For

Break-In & Durability

Many runners say the Vomero 17 feels comfortable right out of the box, with little to no break-in needed. Reviewers who have logged regular mileage often call out dependable traction and cushioning that holds up well over time.

Care & Maintenance

Spot clean the mesh upper with a soft brush or cloth and let the shoes air dry to help preserve the finish. Reviewers also note the outsole tread cleans up easily after regular road use.

descriptionHtml:
Performance powerhouse! Optimise your daily run with the Nike Vomero 18. Featuring a new dual-density midsole with ZoomX foam stacked on top of ReactX foam for a comfortable ride, these upgraded shoes let you push boundaries and run beyond limits. The engineered mesh upper keeps you feeling soft and cool with every giant leap, while the plush tongue and lining wrap your feet in added snugness. Offering maximum cushioning and comfort, the Nike Vomero 18 ensures your every stride is a step towards running greatness.

  • Redesigned podular outsole delivers traction, durability, and support.
  • Heel-to-toe drop: 10 mm.
  • Weight: Approx. 9 oz.

When every mile matters, the Nike Vomero 18 delivers the kind of plush, energized ride that keeps you moving longer and feeling better at the finish. Built around a dual-density midsole that stacks ZoomX foam on top of ReactX foam, it pairs cloud-like softness with responsive bounce — whether you're logging daily training miles or pushing through a longer distance effort. An engineered mesh upper keeps the ride breathable and light, while a plush tongue and lining wrap the foot in a secure, comfortable fit from the first step.

  • Dual-density midsole: ZoomX foam stacked over ReactX foam for maximum cushioning and energy return.
  • Engineered mesh upper for breathability and a soft, lightweight feel.
  • Plush tongue and interior lining for a snug, comfortable wrap.
  • Redesigned podular outsole delivers traction, durability, and support.
  • Heel-to-toe drop: 10 mm. Weight: Approx. 9 oz.

Size & Fit Guidance

The Vomero 18 fits true to size for most runners and offers a generous toe box that accommodates natural foot splay. Runners who typically wear a wide width note that the standard fit works well for them. For those who prefer a little extra room through the forefoot, sizing up a half size is a comfortable option.

Best For

Runners and walkers who prioritize maximum cushioning and all-day comfort, from daily training miles and long runs to casual wear and extended time on your feet.

Cushioning & Road Feel

The stacked ZoomX-over-ReactX midsole creates a noticeably soft, bouncy underfoot sensation that runners consistently describe as effortless and smooth. The redesigned podular outsole provides confident grip on road surfaces, keeping each stride controlled from heel strike through toe-off.

Break-In & Durability

Comfort is immediate with the Vomero 18 — reviewers consistently note the shoe feels great right out of the box with no adjustment period needed. The cushioning holds up well over repeated use, with many runners returning for additional pairs across multiple colorways as a sign of lasting performance.

descriptionHtml:
Experience a new standard of comfort with the Nike Vomero 18 ESS. Designed for the active lifestyle, these sneakers feature a plush responsive midsole that ensures a smooth ride whether you are running or hitting the streets. The breathable fabric upper provides a lightweight feel, while the durable outsole delivers reliable traction for every stride. Stay supported and stylish with the modern athleisure staple in the Nike Vomero 18 ESS.

Features and benefits:

  • Breathable fabric upper offers a lightweight and airy feel.
  • Responsive foam midsole provides plush all-day cushioning.
  • Durable outsole ensures excellent traction on various surfaces.
  • Round bumper toe design adds protection and classic style.
  • Lace-up closure allows for a secure and customized fit.
  • Logo embellishments and color-block details deliver a modern look.

Material and care:

  • Fabric and synthetic upper; foam midsole; rubber outsole.
  • Spot clean.

Size:

  • Low-top silhouette.
  • True to size fit.
  • Mid-vamp coverage.

Long days on your feet, daily training miles, and casual wear all feel easier in a pair built for soft landings and smooth comfort. The Nike Vomero 18 ESS delivers a plush, responsive ride with a breathable upper and a streamlined low-top look that moves easily from runs to everyday routines.

  • Breathable fabric upper for lightweight airflow
  • Plush foam midsole helps create a soft, responsive feel
  • Durable rubber outsole adds reliable traction
  • Lace-up closure secures the fit
  • Low-top silhouette with a padded collar for everyday comfort

Size & Fit Guidance

Most reviewers find the fit true to size with a comfortable amount of cushioning underfoot. For the best fit, we recommend ordering your usual size for everyday wear, while runners who like a little extra toe room may prefer going up a half size.

Best For

Best for daily runs, walking, workouts, and long hours on your feet when comfort is the priority.

Cushioning & Road Feel

Reviewers consistently describe the ride as soft, bouncy, and easy on feet, heels, and knees. The feel leans protective and highly cushioned, making it a strong choice for road miles, treadmill sessions, and all-day wear.

Break-In & Durability

Many wearers say the comfort shows up right away, while those coming from lower-profile trainers may appreciate a few sessions to adjust to the higher-cushion platform. Repeat buyers and frequent runners highlight dependable comfort for regular training, walking, and workday use.

Care & Maintenance

Spot clean as needed and let the shoes air dry to help keep the upper and cushioning looking fresh.

Soft landings make every mile feel smoother in the Nike Vomero Plus, a max-cushion runner built for daily training, long walks, and all-day comfort. Full-length ZoomX foam creates a plush, responsive ride, while the engineered mesh upper keeps the feel breathable and secure from the first step to the last.

Best For

Best for daily runs, long-distance training, recovery miles, walking, and extended time on your feet when plush comfort is the priority.

Cushioning & Road Feel

Reviewers consistently call out the cloud-like softness, smooth bounce, and supportive feel underfoot. The high-stack platform shines on easy runs, long runs, and everyday wear, giving you a protective ride that helps keep legs feeling fresher over distance.

Break-In & Durability

Most reviewers say the comfort shows up right away, though the max-cushion feel may take a run or two to adjust to if you usually wear lower-profile shoes. Reviewers also describe the shoe as a dependable option for repeat miles and regular rotation wear.

Care & Maintenance

Spot clean the mesh upper gently and let the shoes air dry to help preserve their look and feel. Lighter colorways may benefit from quick cleanup after wear to keep them looking fresh.

Featuring a mountainous stack of full-length ZoomX foam, the most responsive foam in the industry, these ultra-light sneakers let you zoom past your running goals in absolute comfort. The high-abrasion rubber outsole offers a firm grip, delivering the optimum traction required for a safe and effective run. It’s time to go the extra mile and redefine your limits with the Nike Vomero Plus!

Nike Vomero Plus features:

  • Engineered mesh upper offers soft breathability.
  • Webbed lace loops provide an adjustable fit.
  • Reflective hits along the toe and heel improve low-light visibility.
  • Weight: 8.1 oz.
  • Heel-to-toe drop: 10 mm.

Soft landings make every mile feel smoother in the Nike Vomero Plus, a max-cushion runner built for daily training, long walks, and all-day comfort. Full-length ZoomX foam creates a plush, responsive ride, while the engineered mesh upper keeps the feel breathable and secure from the first step to the last.

  • Engineered mesh upper for breathable comfort.
  • Full-length ZoomX foam for lightweight cushioning and bounce.
  • Webbed lace loops for an adjustable fit.
  • Reflective hits at the toe and heel for low-light visibility.
  • High-abrasion rubber outsole for durable traction.
  • Weight: 8.1 oz.; heel-to-toe drop: 10 mm.

Size & Fit Guidance

Many reviewers find the fit secure and comfortable for running, walking, and long hours on foot. For the best fit, we recommend going up half a size if you prefer a little extra room in the toe box, while many others are happy in their usual size.

Best For

Best for daily runs, long-distance training, recovery miles, walking, and extended time on your feet when plush comfort is the priority.

Cushioning & Road Feel

Reviewers consistently call out the cloud-like softness, smooth bounce, and supportive feel underfoot. The high-stack platform shines on easy runs, long runs, and everyday wear, giving you a protective ride that helps keep legs feeling fresher over distance.

Break-In & Durability

Most reviewers say the comfort shows up right away, though the max-cushion feel may take a run or two to adjust to if you usually wear lower-profile shoes. Reviewers also describe the shoe as a dependable option for repeat miles and regular rotation wear.

Care & Maintenance

Spot clean the mesh upper gently and let the shoes air dry to help preserve their look and feel. Lighter colorways may benefit from quick cleanup after wear to keep them looking fresh.

descriptionHtml:
For runners who are all about maximum cushioning, the Nike Vomero Plus ESS sets the tone from the very first stride. Featuring a fully stacked, ultra-responsive ZoomX foam midsole, these shoes deliver exceptional energy return and unbridled cushioning to create a remarkable road running experience. The engineered mesh upper, crafted from soft, breathable yarn, ensures lightweight comfort and ventilation mile after mile, while the webbed lace loops keep your foot steady throughout. Whether you’re hitting the pavement or chasing big mileage goals, the Nike Vomero Plus ESS is as serious about running as you are.

Nike Vomero Plus ESS features:

  • Mesh upper offers soft breathability.
  • Reflective details enable low-light visibility.
  • Ultra-responsive ZoomX foam midsole delivers Nike’s highest energy return.
  • High-abrasion rubber outsole offers durable traction.
  • Weight: 8.5 oz
  • Heel-to-toe drop: 10 mm.

Long runs, recovery miles, and busy days on your feet all feel smoother in the Nike Vomero Plus ESS. Built for runners who want a plush ride without giving up energy return, this road-ready silhouette pairs a breathable engineered mesh upper with a fully stacked ZoomX foam midsole for soft landings and a bouncy, protected feel from the first mile to the last.

  • Engineered mesh upper delivers lightweight breathability.
  • Webbed lace loops help create a secure, steady fit.
  • Reflective details add low-light visibility.
  • Full ZoomX foam midsole provides Nike's highest level of energy return.
  • High-abrasion rubber outsole adds durable traction.
  • Weight: 8.5 oz.
  • Heel-to-toe drop: 10 mm.

Size & Fit Guidance

For the best fit, we recommend going true to size if you like a secure, performance feel. If you prefer a little more room through the forefoot or usually size up in cushioned running shoes, many runners found a half-size up worked well.

Best For

Best for daily road miles, long runs, recovery runs, walking, and anyone who wants premium cushioning for extended time on their feet.

Cushioning & Road Feel

Reviewers consistently call out the soft, cloud-like cushioning and springy ride, with many saying it helps reduce fatigue over long distances and full workdays. The feel underfoot leans plush and protective, making it especially well suited to easy miles, endurance training, and all-day comfort.

Break-In & Durability

Most runners found the Vomero Plus ESS comfortable right out of the box, while some noted it settles in even more after a few runs. Repeat buyers also highlight dependable performance across heavy weekly mileage, making it a strong option for steady training rotation use.

descriptionHtml:
'

Unlock your potential and navigate your journey in true Nike style with the Nike Vomero Roam.

Nike Vomero Roam features:

  • Chunky foam midsole gives a visible boost of comfort and style.

Size & Fit Guidance

Most reviewers found the fit true to size. For the best fit, we recommend your usual size for standard wear, or a half size up if you prefer extra toe room, have wider feet, or plan to wear thicker socks in colder weather.

Best For

Styling & Versatility

This design blends runner comfort with winter-shoe utility, giving it a bold, rugged look that stands out in daily rotation. Reviewers especially like how easily it moves between casual wear, outdoor walks, and messy weather without feeling like a traditional boot.

Break-In & Durability

Comfort is a highlight from the start for many wearers, while some note the more structured collar and upper benefit from a short break-in to fully settle in. Once dialed in, the build is widely praised for its sturdy feel and dependable performance in rain, slush, and cold conditions.

Care & Maintenance

Wipe the mudguard and upper clean after mud, slush, or puddles, then let the shoes air dry. Reviewers also note the winterized materials are easy to keep looking fresh for regular cold-weather wear.

The water-repellent finish, together with durable materials, keeps both your feet and shoes fresh, dry, and shielded from the elements. The rubber mudguard maximizes protection from dirt and puddles, while the lightweight High Abrasion Rubber Tech (HART) outsole keeps you well-gripped on wet surfaces. Say yes to the winter plans and spread the cheer with the Nike Vomero Roam.

  • Pull tabs enable easy on and off.

  • Lace toggle with a hook offers an adjustable fit.

*Not intended for use as Personal Protective Equipment (PPE).

Cold mornings, rainy commutes, and weekend plans call for a sneaker that looks polished and handles the elements. The Nike Vomero Roam brings a weather-ready spin to the Vomero line with a water-repellent finish, durable textile and suede layers, and plush cushioning that helps keep every step comfortable from the sidewalk to the trailhead.

  • Rubber mudguard adds extra protection from puddles, dirt, and debris.

Size & Fit Guidance

For the best fit, we recommend ordering your usual size. If you prefer a little extra room or typically wear wider widths, a half-size up may feel more comfortable, especially through the forefoot.

Best For

Best for rainy-day errands, cool-weather commutes, travel, and casual wear when you want everyday comfort with extra weather protection.

Styling & Versatility

With its chunky sole, layered materials, and streamlined toggle-lace setup, this pair brings a rugged, modern look to everyday outfits. Reviewers love how easily it pairs with joggers, leggings, denim, and other casual staples while still feeling ready for changing weather.

Break-In & Durability

The sturdy upper and rubber mudguard earn strong marks for holding up through rain, puddles, and regular wear. Some shoppers note a firmer feel at first, but many say the shoe becomes more comfortable after a few wears as it molds in.

Care & Maintenance

A quick wipe-down after wet or muddy outings helps keep the upper looking fresh, and the rubberized lower portion makes cleanup easier. Let the shoes air-dry naturally after heavy exposure to rain or slush.

Most reviewers say the comfort shows up right away with little to no break-in needed. Some note it feels even better after a few wears, making it a strong option for regular rotation.

To keep the mixed-material upper looking its best, spot clean gently and let it air dry. Regular light cleaning can help preserve the finish and keep the shoe looking fresh for everyday wear.

Your go-to for complexity, depth, and easy style, the Nike Zoom Vomero 5 helps you steal the show effortlessly.

Nike Zoom Vomero 5 features:

Long days on your feet feel easier when comfort and style show up in equal measure.   • Real and synthetic leather upper adds durability.

Best For

Styling & Versatility

Break-In & Durability

Most reviewers say the comfort shows up right away, with little to no break-in needed, while some note it feels even better after a few wears. The layered build and rubber outsole make it a dependable option for frequent everyday use.

Care & Maintenance

To help preserve the look of the mixed-material upper, gentle spot cleaning is the best approach. Letting the shoes air dry after wear can also help keep them looking fresh and feeling ready for the next outing.

Nike Zoom Vomero 5 NA36 features:

  • Synthetic leather on the upper offers durability.
  • Plastic caging on the side enhances support.

Size & Fit Guidance

Best For

Styling & Versatility

Reviewers consistently call out how easy this pair is to wear with everything from leggings and jeans to shorts and skirts. The mix of mesh, glossy overlays, and running-inspired lines gives it enough detail to elevate casual outfits while still feeling right for daily movement.

Many shoppers say the comfort shows up right away, with little to no break-in needed. The supportive build and durable outsole make it a go-to for repeated daily wear, and some pairs feel even better after the first few outings as the shoe settles in.

Care & Maintenance

To help preserve the mesh and layered finishes, gentle spot cleaning with a soft cloth is a smart choice. Let them air dry to keep the materials looking fresh for everyday rotation.

descriptionHtml:
A cozy slip-on design, our soft mule is crafted of luxe, textured haircalf. Designed with a rubber outsole for added traction and a regenerative cotton lining, it’s finished with our tonal Signature hardware for an iconic touch. The lining of this shoe is crafted with cotton sourced from farms that use regenerative agricultural practices––those that help to maintain and rejuvenate land, increase biological diversity, and soil health, and could lead to increased carbon absorption.

descriptionHtml:
Modern good looks and practical durability combine on our wear-everywhere canvas Utility Tote. A spacious style inspired by vintage coal bags, the carry-it-all design has room to hold work, workout or weekend gear with space for a 16" laptop and an interior snap pocket to organize essentials. Exclusive of trim, hardware, and straps, this versatile carryall is crafted with regenerative cotton sourced from farms that use regenerative agricultural practices—those that help to maintain and rejuvenate land, increase biological diversity and soil health, and could lead to increased carbon absorption. It reflects our ongoing commitment to helping reduce our impact on the planet.

descriptionHtml:
'

The adidas Argentina Handball Spezial is a nod to the past with a flair for the present. Originally launched in the ‚Äò70s for indoor sports, these shoes have evolved into a lifestyle staple. Crafted with a supple suede upper, they offer a premium feel that complements their classic design. The soft gum rubber outsole keeps them true to their vintage roots, offering both style and comfort. With the iconic 3-Stripes and OG Spezial branding on the quarter and tongue, these shoes make a statement. Break-In & Durability

Most reviewers say comfort is there from the start, while some note the fit gets even better after a few wears as the materials soften and conform. The suede upper and gum sole also earn praise for their quality feel in regular rotation.

descriptionHtml:
Glide to glory! Bring your A-game with the adidas Originals Handball Spezial. Designed for indoor sports in the ‘70s for elite handball players, these low-profile shoes help you dominate the court and the streets alike. The premium suede upper accented with contrast stitching adds a pop of modern elegance so you can cut and pivot with flexibility, while the gum tooling and T-toe design provide a classic, eye-catching style. From lightning-quick moves to explosive jumps, the adidas Originals Handball Spezial redefines what’s possible on the court.

adidas Originals Handball Spezial features:

  • Regular fit offers a relaxed feel.
  • Leather and synthetic materials ensure comfort and versatility.
  • Lace closure ensures a snug fit.
  • T-toe design adds a classic, vintage look.

Retro indoor-sport style meets easy everyday wear in the adidas Originals Handball Spezial. Originally built for handball in the '70s, this low-profile icon brings a clean, versatile look that feels just as good with jeans, shorts, or more dressed-up casual fits. A premium suede upper, signature T-toe, and gum rubber outsole keep the heritage vibe front and center while giving your rotation a timeless finish.

  • Premium suede upper for a classic look and feel
  • Lace closure helps you dial in the fit
  • Signature T-toe design and contrast details for vintage adidas style
  • Gum rubber outsole adds durable traction and old-school appeal

Size & Fit Guidance

Most reviewers say the Handball Spezial feels comfortable right away and fits true to size. For the best fit, we recommend considering a half-size down if you prefer a more precise, low-profile feel, while those who like a little extra room can stick with their usual size.

Best For

Best for everyday wear, long walks, and anyone who wants a classic sneaker that can shift easily from casual to slightly dressed-up looks.

Styling & Versatility

Reviewers love how easily this silhouette works across outfits, with a slim retro shape that feels polished without trying too hard. It is the kind of pair you can wear on repeat, whether the plan is a full day out, a weekend fit, or a simple everyday rotation.

Break-In & Durability

Many customers find them comfortable out of the box, while some say the fit gets even better after a few wears as the upper settles in. The suede build and gum sole also get consistent praise for their quality feel.

descriptionHtml:
Step into a piece of sneaker history with the adidas Handball Spezial. First designed in 1979 as a high-performance indoor sports shoes, this timeless classic has evolved into a streetwear essential loved for its clean lines, effortless style, and unmistakable retro attitude. This season’s women’s edition brings a fresh expression of the original silhouette, blending archival design with contemporary detailing. A soft suede upper, elevated with distinctive ruffle stripes, brings a feminine twist while staying true to its heritage roots. Signature Spezial branding, including the Trefoil tongue logo and a gold-foil Spezial name on the lateral side completes the look. A durable rubber outsole provides reliable grip for everyday wear, while the leather and textile upper and textile sockliner ensure long-lasting comfort. Celebrate decades of heritage with a feminine twist in the adidas Handball Spezial.

Styling & Versatility

Reviewers love how easily the Handball Spezial pairs with just about anything, giving it true go-to status for daily wear. The streamlined shape, suede build, and gum sole deliver an effortless vintage look that feels equally at home dressed up or kept casual.

Boasting a premium suede upper that's accented by 3-Stripes and other signature details, these archival silhouettes are a nostalgia trip you surely wouldn’t want to miss. Released in 1979 for pro indoor courts and gradually transformed into street-style icons, the adidas Originals Handball Spezial lets you march to the beat of your own drums.

adidas Originals Handball Spezial features:

  • Regular fit offers a relaxed feel.
  • Lace closure ensures a snug fit.
  • Synthetic lining adds breathability.
  • Rubber outsole delivers durability and traction.

Retro court style still hits different when it feels this easy to wear. The adidas Originals Handball Spezial brings its 1979 indoor-sport roots into everyday rotation with a low-profile silhouette, premium suede details, and a classic gum sole that keeps the look timeless. Easy to dress up or down, this women’s pair blends archival adidas DNA with the kind of comfort that makes it an everyday favorite.

  • Premium suede upper with signature 3-Stripes and Spezial branding
  • Lace closure helps secure the fit
  • Synthetic lining adds a smooth, breathable feel
  • Rubber outsole provides durable traction

Size & Fit Guidance

For the best fit, we recommend ordering a half size down, as many reviewers found the Handball Spezial runs a little roomy; some preferred a full size down, while others liked their usual adidas size for a more relaxed feel. Reviews also frequently mention comfortable arch support and cushioning for long days on your feet.

Best For

Best for everyday wear, travel, and casual outfits that shift easily from laid-back to polished.

Styling & Versatility

This is the kind of sneaker reviewers reach for on repeat because it works with almost everything. The slim profile, retro lines, and gum sole give the adidas Originals Handball Spezial an easy mix of sport heritage and street-ready style that pairs well with jeans, trousers, dresses, and more.

Break-In & Durability

Most reviewers describe the comfort as immediate, with a cushioned, supportive feel that holds up well for walking, standing, and daily wear. Some also note the upper feels even better after a few wears as it starts to mold more naturally to the foot.

descriptionHtml:
Experience running nirvana with the ASICS GEL-1130. Spanning decades of design evolution, these innovation-led sneakers enhance your high-impact strides while paying homage to the ninth iteration of the GEL-1000 series. Powered by suede overlays and breathable mesh underlays, these reimagined silhouettes are true masterpieces that make each run a celebration of your passion for brilliance.

The repurposed traditional materials with synthetic leather paneling evolve these shoes for a more modern aesthetic. Plus, the GEL technology in the heel lets you log those long hours of runs with excellent shock absorption and cushioning. Your secret to comfort-fueled running victories – the ASICS GEL-1130 lets you unlock your true potential.

  • Upper inspired by compositional elements of GEL-KAYANO 14 preserves the TRUSSTIC support system and adds stability.
  • Dyed sockliner helps reduce overall water usage by approx. 33% and carbon emissions by approx. 45% and offers sustainable comfort.

Heritage running DNA meets street-ready style in the ASICS GEL-1130, a retro-inspired silhouette rooted in the GEL-1000 series lineage that delivers cloud-like comfort whether you're logging miles or putting together a fresh everyday look. The breathable mesh upper pairs with suede and synthetic leather overlays for a layered build that holds its own across long days, while heel GEL technology cushions every stride with proven shock absorption. Built with a TRUSSTIC support system borrowed from the GEL-KAYANO 14 and a sustainably dyed sockliner, the GEL-1130 earns its place as a go-to for comfort and style in equal measure.

  • Breathable mesh upper with suede and synthetic leather overlays for structure and airflow
  • Heel GEL technology delivers targeted shock absorption and underfoot cushioning
  • Upper inspired by the GEL-KAYANO 14 with TRUSSTIC support system for added stability
  • Dyed sockliner reduces water usage by approx. 33% and carbon emissions by approx. 45%

Size & Fit Guidance

The GEL-1130 fits true to size for most wearers. For the best fit, we recommend ordering your standard size. Those between sizes or with a wider foot may find going up a half size gives a more comfortable feel.

Best For

Perfect for wearers who want all-day comfort and retro running style across casual outings, long shifts, and everyday wear.

Cushioning & Road Feel

Heel GEL cushioning absorbs impact across a variety of surfaces, while the structured midsole delivers stable, comfortable strides mile after mile. The GEL-1130's layered sole construction keeps underfoot feel consistently smooth and plush, from the sidewalk to the track.

Break-In & Durability

Reviewers consistently report the GEL-1130 feels comfortable right out of the box, with wearers noting the shoes continue to look and feel fresh even after weeks of regular use, a strong reflection of ASICS' build quality at this price point.

What if your shoes could train your brain? Introducing the Nike Mind 001, a revolutionary blend of neuroscience and comfort designed to elevate your pregame ritual. Developed by Nike’s Mind Science Department, these pregame mules feature 22 dynamic outsole nodes that gently press against your foot with every step and activate sensory areas of the brain. Train your mind like you train your body and let every step sharpen your edge with the Nike Mind 001.

Nike Mind 001 features:

title: Nike P-6000 - Women's - Anthracite/Black/Black
material: Premium upper with durable overlays and responsive traction outsole

specifications.Material: Premium upper with durable overlays and responsive traction outsole
specifications.Available Sizes (UK): UK 2.5, UK 3, UK 3.5, UK 4, UK 4.5, UK 5, UK 5.5, UK 6, UK 6.5, UK 7, UK 7.5, UK 8, UK 8.5, UK 9, UK 9.5

descriptionHtml:
For athletic style as legendary as a winged horse, look no farther than Nike’s P-6000. This revolutionary shoe combines features from the Pegasus 25 and the Pegasus 2006 for a truly unique design. Leather, textile, and synthetic materials form a striking upper, while a foam midsole cushions each and every step.

  • Upper shows off breathable mesh with vertical and horizontal overlays.
  • Cushioned sock-liner provides comfortable support underfoot.
  • Foam midsole offers lightweight cushioning.
  • Rubber outsole provides durability, traction, and grip.

Long days on your feet call for comfort that still looks put together. The Nike P-6000 blends early-2000s running DNA from the Pegasus 25 and Pegasus 2006 into an everyday sneaker that feels light, cushioned, and easy to wear from workouts to weekend plans.

  • Breathable mesh upper with vertical and horizontal overlays for a layered retro runner look
  • Cushioned sockliner helps add soft support underfoot
  • Foam midsole delivers lightweight comfort for daily wear
  • Rubber outsole adds durable traction and grip

Size & Fit Guidance

Most reviewers say the fit is true to size. For the best fit, we recommend ordering your usual size, with the shape offering enough room for many shoppers who prefer a little extra space through the forefoot.

Best For

Best for all-day walking, travel, errands, light gym sessions, and everyday athleisure wear.

Styling & Versatility

The layered design gives the P-6000 that standout retro running look while still feeling easy to style. It pairs naturally with leggings, denim, joggers, and casual workday fits when you want sporty comfort without sacrificing looks.

Break-In & Durability

Many reviewers say the P-6000 feels comfortable right out of the box, with little to no break-in needed. The mixed-material upper and rubber outsole are built to handle frequent rotation for walking, commuting, and everyday wear.

Care & Maintenance

To keep them looking fresh, clean the mesh and overlays with a soft brush or cloth and mild soap. Some reviewers also note that the shoe is easy to clean, which makes it a strong pick for regular wear.

descriptionHtml:
Performance powerhouse! Optimise your daily run with the Nike Vomero 18. Featuring a new dual-density midsole with ZoomX foam stacked on top of ReactX foam for a comfortable ride, these upgraded shoes let you push boundaries and run beyond limits. The engineered mesh upper keeps you feeling soft and cool with every giant leap, while the plush tongue and lining wrap your feet in added snugness. Offering maximum cushioning and comfort, the Nike Vomero 18 ensures your every stride is a step towards running greatness.

  • Pods around the outsole enhance agility and smoother heel-to-toe transitions.
  • Heel-to-toe drop: 10 mm.
  • Weight: 9.2 oz.

Long walks, recovery miles, and everyday runs feel easier in the Nike Vomero 18. Built for a soft, protected ride, this women's road runner pairs an engineered mesh upper with plush padding and a dual-density midsole that stacks ZoomX foam over ReactX foam for maximum comfort from the first step to the last.

  • Dual-density ZoomX and ReactX cushioning delivers a soft, responsive feel.
  • Engineered mesh upper helps keep the fit breathable.
  • Plush tongue and lining add step-in softness.
  • Outsole pods help create smoother heel-to-toe transitions.
  • 10 mm heel-to-toe drop; approx. 9.2 oz.

Size & Fit Guidance

Most reviewers say the fit feels true to size, with a secure feel and comfortable room through the toe box. For the best fit, we recommend choosing your usual size, or going up a half size if you prefer extra toe room for walking, training, or longer runs.

Best For

Best for runners and walkers who want maximum cushioning for daily miles, treadmill sessions, long shifts, and all-day comfort.

Cushioning & Road Feel

Reviewers consistently describe the ride as cloud-like, bouncy, and easy on feet, heels, and knees. The high-cushion platform helps soften road impact while keeping transitions smooth and comfortable.

Break-In & Durability

Most buyers say comfort is immediate, with little to no break-in needed. Several longtime Vomero wearers and frequent runners also note that the shoe holds up well for regular walking, training, and repeated miles.

Styling & Versatility

Break-In & Durability

descriptionHtml:
Your daily runs just became more enjoyable! Introducing the Nike Vomero Plus—everyday runners that take maximum cushioning to the next level. Featuring a mountainous stack of full-length ZoomX foam, the most responsive foam in the industry, these ultra-light sneakers let you zoom past your running goals in absolute comfort. The high-abrasion rubber outsole offers a firm grip, delivering the optimum traction required for a safe and effective run. It’s time to go the extra mile and redefine your limits with the Nike Vomero Plus!

Nike Vomero Plus features:

  • Engineered mesh upper offers soft breathability.
  • Webbed lace loops provide an adjustable fit.
  • Reflective hits along the toe and heel improve low-light visibility.
  • Weight: 8.1 oz.
  • Heel-to-toe drop: 10 mm.

Soft landings make every mile feel smoother in the Nike Vomero Plus, a max-cushion runner built for daily training, long walks, and all-day comfort. Full-length ZoomX foam creates a plush, responsive ride, while the engineered mesh upper keeps the feel breathable and secure from the first step to the last.

  • Engineered mesh upper for breathable comfort.
  • Full-length ZoomX foam for lightweight cushioning and bounce.
  • Webbed lace loops for an adjustable fit.
  • Reflective hits at the toe and heel for low-light visibility.
  • High-abrasion rubber outsole for durable traction.
  • Weight: 8.1 oz.; heel-to-toe drop: 10 mm.

Size & Fit Guidance

Many reviewers find the fit secure and comfortable for running, walking, and long hours on foot. For the best fit, we recommend going up half a size if you prefer a little extra room in the toe box, while many others are happy in their usual size.

Best For

Best for daily runs, long-distance training, recovery miles, walking, and extended time on your feet when plush comfort is the priority.

Cushioning & Road Feel

Reviewers consistently call out the cloud-like softness, smooth bounce, and supportive feel underfoot. The high-stack platform shines on easy runs, long runs, and everyday wear, giving you a protective ride that helps keep legs feeling fresher over distance.

Break-In & Durability

Most reviewers say the comfort shows up right away, though the max-cushion feel may take a run or two to adjust to if you usually wear lower-profile shoes. Reviewers also describe the shoe as a dependable option for repeat miles and regular rotation wear.

Care & Maintenance

Spot clean the mesh upper gently and let the shoes air dry to help preserve their look and feel. Lighter colorways may benefit from quick cleanup after wear to keep them looking fresh.

descriptionHtml:
'

Elevate your cold-weather adventures and conquer wet trails with the Nike Vomero Roam. Constructed with a textile and suede upper, these shoes feature a water-repellent finish that keeps your feet fresh, dry, and comfortable all day. The easy-to-adjust lace toggles with a hook offer a customized fit, while the Nike Air Zoom units provide responsive cushioning and energy return. Boasting a High Abrasion Rubber Tech (HART) outsole, these lightweight silhouettes use less rubber compound than other XDR technologies, enhancing durability and abrasion resistance. Unlock your potential and navigate your journey in true Nike style with the Nike Vomero Roam.

Nike Vomero Roam features:

  • Reflective details enable low-light visibility.
  • Chunky foam midsole gives a visible boost of comfort and style.
  • Rubber mudguard maximizes protection from dirt and puddles.
  • Rubber outsole offers durable traction.

*Not intended for use as Personal Protective Equipment (PPE).

Cold, wet days call for comfort, grip, and coverage without switching to a full boot. Built for everyday wear in unpredictable weather, the Nike Vomero Roam brings the cushioned feel of the Vomero line into a rugged, winter-ready design that stays comfortable from commutes to long walks.

  • Textile and suede upper with a water-repellent finish
  • Easy-to-adjust toggle lacing with a hook for quick fit changes
  • Nike Air Zoom units and a chunky foam midsole for cushioned comfort
  • Rubber mudguard helps block out dirt and puddles
  • Reflective details add visibility in low light
  • High Abrasion Rubber Tech outsole helps deliver durable traction

Size & Fit Guidance

Most reviewers found the fit true to size. For the best fit, we recommend your usual size for standard wear, or a half size up if you prefer extra toe room, have wider feet, or plan to wear thicker socks in colder weather.

Best For

Best for cold commutes, rainy-day errands, travel, and everyday walking when you want sneaker comfort with added weather protection.

Styling & Versatility

This design blends runner comfort with winter-shoe utility, giving it a bold, rugged look that stands out in daily rotation. Reviewers especially like how easily it moves between casual wear, outdoor walks, and messy weather without feeling like a traditional boot.

Break-In & Durability

Comfort is a highlight from the start for many wearers, while some note the more structured collar and upper benefit from a short break-in to fully settle in. Once dialed in, the build is widely praised for its sturdy feel and dependable performance in rain, slush, and cold conditions.

Care & Maintenance

Wipe the mudguard and upper clean after mud, slush, or puddles, then let the shoes air dry. Reviewers also note the winterized materials are easy to keep looking fresh for regular cold-weather wear.

"

descriptionHtml:
Calling the free spirits!! Chart your course with the adidas Originals Handball Spezial. Brimming with sophistication and style, these low-profile sneakers channel an always-on retro vibe that echoes undeniable coolness. But wait, these shoes get better. Boasting a premium suede upper that's accented by 3-Stripes and other signature details, these archival silhouettes are a nostalgia trip you surely wouldn’t want to miss. Released in 1979 for pro indoor courts and gradually transformed into street-style icons, the adidas Originals Handball Spezial lets you march to the beat of your own drums.

adidas Originals Handball Spezial features:

  • Regular fit offers a relaxed feel.
  • Lace closure ensures a snug fit.
  • Synthetic lining adds breathability.
  • Rubber outsole delivers durability and traction.

Retro court style still hits different when it feels this easy to wear. The adidas Originals Handball Spezial brings its 1979 indoor-sport roots into everyday rotation with a low-profile silhouette, premium suede details, and a classic gum sole that keeps the look timeless. Easy to dress up or down, this women’s pair blends archival adidas DNA with the kind of comfort that makes it an everyday favorite.

  • Premium suede upper with signature 3-Stripes and Spezial branding
  • Lace closure helps secure the fit
  • Synthetic lining adds a smooth, breathable feel
  • Rubber outsole provides durable traction

Size & Fit Guidance

For the best fit, we recommend ordering a half size down, as many reviewers found the Handball Spezial runs a little roomy; some preferred a full size down, while others liked their usual adidas size for a more relaxed feel. Reviews also frequently mention comfortable arch support and cushioning for long days on your feet.

Best For

Best for everyday wear, travel, and casual outfits that shift easily from laid-back to polished.

Styling & Versatility

This is the kind of sneaker reviewers reach for on repeat because it works with almost everything. The slim profile, retro lines, and gum sole give the adidas Originals Handball Spezial an easy mix of sport heritage and street-ready style that pairs well with jeans, trousers, dresses, and more.

Break-In & Durability

Most reviewers describe the comfort as immediate, with a cushioned, supportive feel that holds up well for walking, standing, and daily wear. Some also note the upper feels even better after a few wears as it starts to mold more naturally to the foot.
